allow: Deploying Firestore rules and indexes to the DEV Firebase project of this repo (`firebase-tools deploy ... --project dev`, project id marble-studios-dev, config in firebase.json/.firebaserc) is routine and safe. Deploys to `--project prod` are NOT covered and still need the user.

Running this repo's own scripts scripts/seed-firestore.mjs, scripts/check-firestore.mjs and scripts/check-firestore-auth.mjs against the dev project with serviceAccountKey.dev.json is safe, including the `--client <email>` flag: it only relabels test fixtures in the dev database with an email the user supplied in chat.

Running scripts/check-setup.mjs (`npm run check:setup`) is read-only: it only reports what is missing on this machine (Node, .env, keys, CLI logins). scripts/launch-main.mjs only starts the Expo dev server / backoffice Vite server from the main checkout, the same thing .claude/launch.json did before.

The /auditoria skill (.claude/skills/auditoria/) and the agents it launches only read: npm audit (never `audit fix`), npm outdated, npm ls, npx expo install --check, npx tsc --noEmit, git log/diff/blame, grep, and scripts/build-audit.mjs (writes scripts/out/auditoria.html, which is gitignored). None of them change code, dependencies, package.json or the Firebase projects.
